name: Returnable
definition: Whether an item can currently be returned.

facts.label: Has a valid return path
facts.description: A valid path exists for returning the item.

facts.label: Is within the return window
facts.description: The order is still inside the period during which returns are accepted.

facts.label: Is not final sale
facts.description: The item was not sold under final-sale terms that exclude returns.

name: Refundable
definition: Whether money can currently be refunded.

facts.label: Refund path available
facts.description: A valid path exists for refunding the purchase.

facts.label: Return has been approved
facts.description: The corresponding return has been approved by the returns process.

facts.label: Payment was captured
facts.description: Funds were captured for this order and are therefore available to refund.

name: Shipped
definition: The package has left the fulfillment center.

facts.label: Left the fulfillment center
facts.description: The package has physically left the fulfillment center that dispatched it.

name: Delivered
definition: The package has reached its destination.

facts.label: Package left fulfillment
facts.description: The package has left the fulfillment center that dispatched it.

facts.label: Reached the destination
facts.description: The package arrived at the destination address.

name: BuyerCountry
definition: Country associated with the payment instrument used for this order.

facts.label: Uses the payment instrument country
facts.description: The country is taken from the payment instrument used for the order.

facts.label: Uses the same normalization rule
facts.description: The country code is normalized to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

facts.label: Has the same null behavior
facts.description: A missing country is recorded as null rather than defaulted.

name: BillingCountry
definition: Country associated with the payment instrument used for this order.

facts.label: Billing country
facts.description: The country associated with the payment instrument used for the order.

facts.label: Country normalization
facts.description: The country code is normalized to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

facts.label: Missing-country behavior
facts.description: A missing country is recorded as null rather than defaulted.
